title: action_bar
summary: Benilla defines the 120-slot SMSG_ACTION_BUTTONS packed-u32 login snapshot (action bits 0-23, kind bits 24-31, zero=empty) and the 5-byte CMSG_SET_ACTION_BUTTON (u8 slot + u32 packed). MSUI implements both: PlayerActions.ApplyButtons parses the snapshot and WorldSession.BuildSetActionButtonBody writes u8+u32, wired to the one-send-per-local-mutation drag model in GameLoop.ActionBars.cs. Current Benilla also exposes a one-byte CMSG_SET_ACTIONBAR_TOGGLES post for four options-page visibility switches. MSUI intentionally preserves its established multibar presentation and has no corresponding visibility-option consumer; the opcode is inventoried but a disconnected sender is not added.
